scriptedContent.risksQuestion: What are the biggest risks in this project?
scriptedContent.risksAnswer:
Three risks come up repeatedly across your project documents.

Timeline. The integration milestone assumes vendor delivery in week six, but your retro notes record two earlier slips of two to three weeks each.

A single dependency. The spec names one identity provider and no fallback path is documented anywhere in the collection.

Unestimated scope. The risk register flags the analytics work as unestimated, and it is still on the v1 list.
scriptedContent.visionAnswer:
Mostly, with one gap.

Your screenshot puts the review step after submission. The specification puts review before it, so the confirmation copy on this screen would appear too late to be useful.

Everything else matches: field order, the optional note, and the two-button footer.
scriptedContent.mcpQuestion: Check GitHub for open issues about these.
scriptedContent.mcpAnswer:
Two open issues look related.

#418, Identity provider fallback, is unassigned and describes the same single-provider risk your spec has. #402, Analytics scope, is tagged needs-estimate.

Neither is on the current milestone, which is probably the thing worth raising.
